VBO:0200018.summary: People-oriented but sometimes stubborn in her owner’s account, five-year-old Naomi offers an individual glimpse of the Alaskan Shepherd, an Alaskan Malamute–German Shepherd cross. She enjoyed car rides and playing with people more than with other dogs. Rather than barking often, she made a “woooo” talking sound and howled at sirens; she could also be pushy when meeting dogs.
